children: DICK'S Sporting Goods entered into an underwriting agreement to issue $1.0 billion of senior notes for general corporate purposes. The offering comprises $400 million of 6.200% notes due 2036 and $600 million of 6.900% notes due 2056. The unsecured, unsubordinated notes were sold through BofA Securities, PNC Capital Markets and Wells Fargo Securities as representatives of the underwriters. Proceeds may be used for operations, debt repayment, share repurchases and potential acquisitions.
